```{r}
install.packages("openxlsx")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("lubridate")
install.packages("car")
install.packages("forecast")
install.packages("glarma")
```


```{r}
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(car)
library(forecast)
library(glarma)
```

```{r}
data <- read.xlsx("../resources/incendios-florestais-em-areas-protegidas-boi-areas-protegidas-2019-marco.xlsx", sheet = 1)

data$DataHoraDeteccao <- convertToDate(data$DataHoraDeteccao)
data$DataDeteccao <- convertToDate(data$DataDeteccao)
data$InicioCombate <- convertToDate(data$InicioCombate)
data$TerminoCombate <- convertToDate(data$TerminoCombate)
```

```{r}
agg_df <- data |> group_by(month_year=floor_date(DataDeteccao, "month")) |> summarise(qty = n_distinct(NumBOI))
```

```{r}
y <- ts(agg_df[,2], start=c(2019,1), frequency = 12)
```

```{r}
n_months = 12 
ts.plot(y, xlab="month_year", ylab="qty"); abline(v = time(y)[seq(n_months, length(y), by = n_months)], col = "red", lty = 3)
```

```{r}
ts.plot(diff(y), xlab="month_year", ylab="qty")
```

```{r}
acf(diff(y))
pacf(diff(y))
```

```{r}
ts.plot(diff(diff(y), 12), xlab="month_year", ylab="qty")
```

```{r}
acf(diff(diff(y), 12))
pacf(diff(diff(y), 12))
```
```{r}
plot(stl(y[,1], s.window="periodic"))
```
# Modeling
## ARIMA(2,1,2) com sazonalidade a cada 12 meses.

```{r}
sarima_model <- arima(y, order=c(2,1,2), seasonal=list(order=c(2,1,2), period=12))
sarima_model
```
```{r}
linearHypothesis(sarima_model, c("ar1 = 0", "ar2 = 0", "ma1 = 0", "ma2 = 0", "sar1 = 0", "sar2 = 0", "sma1 = 0", "sma2 = 0"))
```


```{r}
acf(sarima_model$residuals)
```
```{r}
qqPlot(sarima_model$residuals)
```


```{r}
Box.test(sarima_model$residuals, lag = 11, type = "Ljung-Box")
```

```{r}
aa_model <- auto.arima(y)
summary(aa_model)
```
```{r}
acf(aa_model$residuals)
```
```{r}
qqPlot(aa_model$residuals)
```

```{r}
Box.test(aa_model$residuals, lag = 11, type = "Ljung-Box")
```
Criar modelo garma com variável explicativa do periodo de junho a setembro (meses mais secos)

```{r}
dry_weather <- as.numeric(as.numeric(format(agg_df$month_year, "%m")) %in% 6:9)
X <- cbind(intercept = 1, dry_weather = dry_weather)

garma_model <- glarma(y, X, phiLags=c(1), thetaLags=c(2))
garma_model
```

```{r}
acf(garma_model$residuals)
```
```{r}
qqPlot(garma_model$residuals)
```
